title: Kelowna Inaugural Council Meeting & Swearing-In (2026–2030)
location: Mary Irwin Theatre, Rotary Centre for the Arts, 421 Cawston Ave, Kelowna, BC
desc: Judge Clarke Burnett administers the Oath of Office to Mayor Tom Dyas and Councillors Les Bellamy, Kevin Kraft, Davis Kyle, Gord Lovegrove, Brady Rogers, Mohini Singh, Laura Thurnheer and Rick Webber. One-hour ceremony followed by a public coffee and appetizer reception until 9 p.m. Open to the public; livestreamed at kelowna.ca/council. Good networking opportunity with the new council.

title: West Kelowna Inaugural Council Meeting + First Regular Meeting
location: West Kelowna City Hall Council Chambers, 3731 Old Okanagan Hwy, West Kelowna, BC
desc: Acclaimed Mayor Stephen Johnston and Councillors Justin Chapman, Tasha Da Silva, Rick de Jong, Tom Groat, Garrett Millsap and Chris Moyer are sworn in, followed by the first regular council meeting. Expect appointments to the RDCO board. Public welcome; webcast at westkelownacity.ca/webcasts. In Dan Albas's riding.

title: Peachland Inaugural Council Meeting & Swearing-In
location: Peachland Council Chambers, Peachland Community Centre, 4450 6th Street, Peachland, BC
desc: Corporate Officer Jennifer Sawatzky administers the oath to Mayor-elect Gail Mansell and six councillors-elect. Peachland is in Dan Albas's riding. Venue is where Peachland council normally meets; confirm on peachland.ca.

title: West Kelowna Agricultural Advisory Committee
location: West Kelowna City Hall Council Chambers, 3731 Old Okanagan Hwy, West Kelowna, BC
desc: Monthly meeting (first Wednesday) of the City of West Kelowna Agricultural Advisory Committee. Open to the public.

title: Accelerate Okanagan OFFSITE (founders & C-suite)
location: KF Centre for Excellence, Kelowna, BC
desc: Accelerate Okanagan's all-day event for founders and C-suite leaders, presented by TELUS: keynotes, panels, workshops and a closing networking happy hour. Exact hours weren't published; check Accelerate Okanagan.

title: DEADLINE: Register for 'Trade Diversification' with Canada's Chief Trade Commissioner
desc: Registration deadline for the Nov 10 event in Kelowna. The Trade Commissioner Service lists Nov 5; Tourism Kelowna's roundup says registration through the Kelowna Chamber closes Nov 3.

title: Indigenous Veterans Day (Westbank First Nation ceremony: date TBC)
location: WFN Cenotaph, 1900 Quail Lane, Westbank, BC
desc: National Indigenous Veterans Day. Westbank First Nation, which sits in the heart of the riding, holds a public ceremony at its cenotaph every year; in 2025 it was held the Friday before (Nov 7, 10:30 a.m.–noon, lunch to follow). Nov 8 2026 is a Sunday, so check wfn.ca for this year's date. Chief, council and local elected officials usually attend.

title: Kelowna City Council: First Regular Meeting of New Term
location: Council Chamber, Kelowna City Hall, 1435 Water Street, Kelowna, BC
desc: First regular meeting of the 2026–2030 council. Kelowna's regular public meetings are Mondays at 1:30 p.m.; council also meets Monday mornings at 9 a.m. for policy and in-camera business. Livestreamed at kelowna.ca/council. Check the agenda for the exact times.

title: Trade Diversification: Where Do We Stand? (Sara Wilshaw, Chief Trade Commissioner)
location: Kelowna Innovation Centre (Theatre), 460 Doyle Avenue, Kelowna, BC
desc: A three-hour in-person session led by Sara Wilshaw, Canada's Chief Trade Commissioner, with the Kelowna Chamber, on diversifying into EU and Indo-Pacific markets. Highly relevant to federal trade policy and government relations. The start time wasn't published; registration closes Nov 5.

title: Remembrance Day: Kelowna (Legion Branch #26)
location: City Park Cenotaph, 1600 Abbott St, Kelowna, BC
desc: The region's largest ceremony: a parade from Bernard Ave & Water St to the City Park cenotaph, organized by Royal Canadian Legion Kelowna Branch #26. Elected officials lay wreaths. Times are based on past years; confirm closer to the date.

title: Remembrance Day: West Kelowna (Legion Branch #288)
location: Royal LePage Place, 2760 Cameron Rd, West Kelowna, BC
desc: Honour parade at 10 a.m., service 10:45 a.m.–noon, moment of silence at 11. Hosted by Royal Canadian Legion Westbank Branch #288. The MP and local councils usually attend. Times are based on past years; confirm closer to the date.

title: Remembrance Day: Peachland (Legion Branch #69)
location: Cenotaph Park, Beach Ave & 2nd St, Peachland, BC
desc: Ceremony at Cenotaph Park with a reception afterwards at Legion Branch #69. Times are based on past years; confirm closer to the date.

title: Remembrance Day: Summerland
location: Memorial Park, Wharton Street, Summerland, BC
desc: Parade of Legion members, veterans and the Summerland Pipe Band leaves Wharton St at 10:30 a.m. and marches to the Memorial Park cenotaph; two minutes of silence at 11. The Legion (14205 Rosedale Ave) opens at noon. Times are based on past years.

title: 35th Innkeeper's Gala: 'A Diamond Affair' (Hotel Eldorado 100th)
location: Hotel Eldorado, 500 Cook Rd, Kelowna, BC
desc: Billed as Kelowna's top charitable event; more than 350 guests and usually sells out. Proceeds go to Okanagan College's Centre for Food, Wine and Tourism and Kelowna General Hospital (including JoeAnna's House). A VIP 'Elevated Prelude' runs before the gala. Business and civic leaders attend. Tickets on Eventbrite.

title: Kelowna: First Public Hearing of New Council
location: Council Chamber, Kelowna City Hall, 1435 Water Street, Kelowna, BC
desc: The new council's first Tuesday public hearing and regular meeting on development and zoning applications. The City's council guide lists Tuesday hearings at 4 p.m.; confirm on the agenda at kelowna.ca/council.

title: West Kelowna Advisory Planning Commission
location: West Kelowna City Hall Council Chambers, 3731 Old Okanagan Hwy, West Kelowna, BC
desc: Monthly meeting (third Wednesday) of the APC, which reviews land-use and development applications before they go to council.

title: Tree of Hope Festival
location: Landmark District, 1700 Dickson Ave, Kelowna, BC
desc: Community holiday kickoff and charity festival at the Landmark District. Start time is from Eventbrite; the end time is an estimate.

title: West Kelowna Accessibility & Inclusion Committee
location: West Kelowna City Hall, 3731 Old Okanagan Hwy, West Kelowna, BC
desc: Scheduled meeting of the City of West Kelowna Accessibility and Inclusion Committee. Time not listed; check the city's calendar.

title: RDCO Inaugural Regular Board Meeting (new board, chair election)
location: RDCO Woodhaven Boardroom, 1450 KLO Rd, Kelowna, BC
desc: First meeting of the new Regional District of Central Okanagan board after the election; the chair and vice-chair are elected. Directors come from Kelowna, West Kelowna, Peachland, Lake Country and the electoral areas, with Westbank First Nation as a non-voting member. Streamed at rdco.com/board.
